title: Happy and Healthy Living
seo_title: Happy and Healthy Living Class 4 EVS Worksheet (NCERT Our Wondrous World Ch 6)
standard_code: Class 4, Our Wondrous World Chapter 6: Happy and Healthy Living
standard_text: Good habits for a healthy body and mind: cleanliness, exercise, yoga, sleep and rest; how some common diseases spread and how to prevent them; simple first aid; safety; sharing feelings and caring for each other (summary of NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 6).
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 4 EVS worksheets for NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 6: healthy habits, exercise and yoga, sleep, how diseases spread, first aid, safety and feelings. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Healthy habits keep the body and mind happy.
key_sub: Clean hands, exercise, rest and kind words.
body_html:
How to think about it

We stay healthy by keeping clean, eating well, exercising, playing outdoors and sleeping for about 9 to 11 hours. Washing hands with soap, covering coughs, drinking clean water and not letting water stand near our homes stop many diseases. Cholera spreads through dirty water and malaria through mosquito bites.

Simple first aid helps with small injuries: wash and cover a cut, cool a burn under running water. A happy mind matters too: share your feelings, include others and ask a trusted adult for help.

Example

A minor burn: what first?

cool it

Answer: hold it under cool running water

Example

Malaria spreads by…

an insect

Answer: the bite of an infected mosquito

Common mistakes

  • Thinking water alone removes germs from hands.
  • Putting ice or butter on a burn.
  • Hiding sad or angry feelings.

faq.q: How can we stop mosquitoes breeding?
faq.a: Do not let water collect in coolers, tyres, pots and drains; empty and cover containers.
Sleep rests the body and mind and helps children grow and learn.
